notes: This is a candidate-entry screen, not pathogen selection or a Picked decision.
High, medium, and low_colonizer entry tiers are all retained for the future test-aware scorer.
Only evaluable selected observations with reads greater than zero enter scorer tiers.
Unmapped organisms go to taxonomy review before scorer entry, never to automatic Picked.
Repeated seq_id observations from one specimen indicate technical test support, not independent clinical confirmation.
Rank is within the supplied retained test universe and does not compare raw reads across DNA/RNA tests.
Physician answers and the old selected-DNA baseline do not affect routing.
